lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So you took the checkpoint to school. In your backpack.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Checkpoint saved.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Skateboard trick? Attempt one. [pause] Attempt two. [pause] Attempt twenty-three.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Attempt fifty-seven...

lines.speaker: KID
lines.text: [amazed] WHOA! Did you see that?! First try!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [smug] Yeah. First try.

lines.speaker: TIP
lines.text: [whispering] TIP: That was not first try.

lines.speaker: TEACHER
lines.text: [bored] Pop quiz. Twenty questions. No talking.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A pop quiz? No problem. You read all the questions... [pause] and then you pressed reset.

lines.speaker: TIP
lines.text: [suspicious] TIP: That's... cheating.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: [deadpan] It was one hundred percent cheating. [pause] You got one hundred percent.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: [loud] Dodgeball! Let's GO!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Dodgeball? You'd already been hit by every single ball. [pause] So you knew where every single ball was going.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: [stunned] Kid... where have you BEEN all my life?!

lines.speaker: IVY
lines.text: [suspicious] How did you know it was coming? You didn't even look!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [casual] Lucky guess.

lines.speaker: TIP
lines.text: [whispering] TIP: It was not a lucky guess.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At lunch, you told a joke. [pause] It was terrible. [pause] Reset. [pause] Thirty-one tries later...

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [confident] ...and that's why the cafeteria pizza has its own fan club. [pause] It's called "The Survivors."

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: [proud] The whole cafeteria laughed. Somebody laughed milk out of their nose.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [glowing] This is the best day of my LIFE! [pause] Two hundred and fourteen times in a row!
